clue.text: Monotonous way to vocalise with instrument

blocks.note: humming is voicing a tune with closed lips
a percussion instrument

explanation.surface: Someone complains that singing along to an instrument makes for a dull performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Humdrum describes something dull and lacking variety, a close synonym of monotonous.

clue.text: Dissenter in this position joining spasmodic movement

blocks.note: here means at this place
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: A rebel takes up a post here and starts twitching.
explanation.definitionFit: A heretic holds views at odds with accepted doctrine, so is a dissenter from orthodoxy.

clue.text: Million I bet in error

blocks.note: M is the abbreviation for million
taken as written
a stake is money wagered

explanation.surface: A gambler admits wagering a million by accident.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistake is a wrong act or judgement, a plain synonym for an error.

clue.text: Libertine consuming good kind of wine from France

indicators.note: consuming means taking in, so one piece swallows the other

blocks.note: a roué is a debauched man
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A rake drinks a fine French wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Rouge is French for red, and vin rouge is French red wine.

clue.text: One of best three dinners initially found in menu?

indicators.note: initially keeps only the opening letter of the word before it
found in places one piece inside the other

blocks.note: a menu is a list of what a meal offers; it wraps the next piece
the first letter of dinners

explanation.surface: Is a medal-winner's dinner on the menu?
explanation.walkthrough: D goes into MEAL LIST after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold, silver and bronze go to the top three, so a medallist is one of the best three.

clue.text: Within remaining time, is becoming red

indicators.note: within says the following short word sits inside the other pieces

blocks.note: what is left is what remains
taken as written
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Over the time that remains, someone's politics are turning red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Within' applies to the time that remains: the word is sits inside that stretch, between its two parts.
explanation.definitionFit: A red is a communist or socialist, someone politically on the left wing.

clue.text: Chopping out odd pieces, always fears powerful cutter

indicators.note: cutting away the odd-numbered positions leaves only the even ones behind

blocks.note: the second, fourth, sixth, eighth and tenth letters

explanation.surface: Someone forever frightened of losing bits while chopping meets a mighty blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A laser beam can slice through metal, making it a powerful cutting tool.

clue.text: Expedition for students if led badly leads to fall

indicators.note: doing something badly means getting it wrong, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: taken as written
a trip is a stumble or fall

explanation.surface: A school outing, if poorly guided, ends with someone taking a tumble.
explanation.definitionFit: A field trip is an educational outing where students study things away from the classroom.

clue.text: First letter one found in old language, then another one turned up

indicators.note: found in places one piece inside the other
in a down clue turned up means read from the bottom, so the whole is reversed

blocks.note: the classical language of Rome; it wraps the next piece
I is the Roman numeral for one
a second Roman one

explanation.surface: The first letter of an ancient language, then another, turned upside down.
explanation.walkthrough: I goes into LATIN after LA, another I is added, and LAITINI reads upward.
explanation.definitionFit: An initial is the first letter of a name or word.

clue.text: Author raised fortune with second play

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means lifted upward, so the word reads from bottom to top

blocks.note: one's lot is one's fate or fortune
S is the abbreviation for second
to toy is to play with

explanation.surface: A writer raised a fortune with his second stage play.
explanation.definitionFit: Leo Tolstoy was the Russian novelist who wrote War and Peace and Anna Karenina.

clue.text: Ring concerning something we hear

blocks.note: re means about or concerning
a sound is what reaches the ear

explanation.surface: A ring concerns a noise that we can hear.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring out loudly and echo is to resound, a verb synonym for reverberating.

clue.text: Out of the ordinary places I recollected

indicators.note: re-collected means gathered up again, so the letters are reassembled in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Somebody remembers some unusual places they once visited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recollected' reads as remembered, but split as re-collected it signals rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Special means exceptional or unusual, the same idea as being out of the ordinary.

clue.text: Representative who's becoming more broad-minded?

blocks.note: first meaning: a commercial ..., a sales representative on the road
second meaning: a playful hint at the saying that travel broadens the mind

explanation.walkthrough: The second half leans on the proverb that travel broadens the mind, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A travelling salesman was called a commercial traveller, and anyone journeying abroad is supposedly widening their outlook.

clue.text: Quarrel started by daughter, in essence

indicators.note: started by places the second piece at the front of the first

blocks.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter
a rift is a falling-out

explanation.surface: A family quarrel begun by a daughter, in essence.
explanation.definitionFit: The drift of an argument is its general gist or underlying meaning, its essence.

clue.text: Stuff covering cake finally?

indicators.note: finally keeps only the closing letter of the word before it
covering means wrapping around, so one piece goes outside the other

blocks.note: to stuff is to cram; it wraps around the next piece
the last letter of cake

explanation.surface: Asks what substance goes on top of a cake as its finishing touch.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: cream is the stuff spread over a cake at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Cream is commonly spread or piped over a cake as a topping, the last stage of decorating.

clue.text: Low number accepting call for peace? Nonsense

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the call goes inside the number

blocks.note: a cow lows, making a moo
a number; it takes in the next piece
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: A quiet number asking for peace is dismissed as nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low' is the verb for what a cow does, not a small value.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonshine is an informal word for foolish talk or fanciful ideas, i.e. nonsense.

clue.text: I recover without male doctor, in unethical way

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means these pieces go around the others

blocks.note: taken as written
M is the abbreviation for male
MO is a medical officer
to rally is to recover strength

explanation.surface: A patient says they got better without seeing a male doctor, which seems somehow unethical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' is used in its old sense of outside, so I and recover go round the male doctor rather than doing without him.
explanation.definitionFit: Immorally is the adverb for acting against moral principles, which is acting unethically.

clue.text: Maine's not mistaken for another state

indicators.note: mistaken means got wrong, so these letters are set in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Maine should not be confused with some other US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnesota is a US state, so it is a state other than Maine.

clue.text: Achieved 50% of score after pro not recalled

indicators.note: after places the first pieces mentioned behind the one named next

blocks.note: pro means in favour of
got means obtained or achieved
a score is twenty, and half of it is ten

explanation.surface: A sportsman scored half marks after turning professional.
explanation.walkthrough: A score is twenty, so half a score is ten.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forgotten has slipped from memory and is not recalled, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Anxious female with expression of disgust when trapped by rodent

indicators.note: being trapped means being held inside, so one piece sits within the other

blocks.note: F is the abbreviation for female
a rat is a rodent; it traps the next piece
ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: A woman grimaces in disgust, worried at being cornered by a rat.
explanation.definitionFit: Fraught describes being tense and anxious, as in a fraught atmosphere.

clue.text: Was ruler guided like Arab, from what we hear?

indicators.note: what we hear is speech, so the word is judged by its sound, not its spelling

blocks.note: an Arab horse is steered with reins

explanation.surface: Asks whether a ruler steered like an Arab horse, as rumour goes.
explanation.walkthrough: An Arab here is the breed of horse, guided by reins.
explanation.definitionFit: To reign is to rule as monarch, so a ruler reigned.

clue.text: Leaders of parties on left and right, as different as can be

indicators.note: leaders are those at the front, so only each word's opening letter is kept

blocks.note: the first letters of the five words

explanation.surface: Party leaders on the left and right of politics are completely unlike each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar opposites lie at either end of a scale, as unlike each other as possible.

clue.text: Flower-girl covering up about it without breaking law

indicators.note: covering up means wrapping around, so the girl's name goes outside

blocks.note: a girl's name that is also a flower; it wraps the next pieces
C stands for circa, about
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl selling flowers hides something, but stays within the law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower-girl' suggests a seller of flowers, but it is a girl named after a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Licit means lawful, so acting licitly is acting without breaking the law.

clue.text: About fifty, fired, took it easy

blocks.note: re means about
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
axed means sacked

explanation.surface: A man around fifty, sacked from his job, put his feet up.
explanation.definitionFit: To have relaxed is to have rested or eased off, which is to have taken it easy.

clue.text: A voyage back as result of making a name for oneself

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word for the voyage from end to start

blocks.note: taken as written
a sail is a trip by boat

explanation.surface: A sea journey home that brought someone fame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making a name for oneself' sounds like becoming famous; the definition is literally a name one gives oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: An alias is an assumed name a person adopts in place of their real one.

clue.text: Accepts I must change line that's dubious

indicators.note: a change of order is demanded, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
L is the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: Someone concedes they must alter a policy they doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: Sceptical means doubtful or questioning, so it matches dubious in the sense of unconvinced.

clue.text: Thrilled over minimal money being paid out

indicators.note: over here means spread across, so the outer word wraps around the coin

blocks.note: sent in the slang sense of excited or delighted
p for penny, the smallest coin

explanation.surface: Someone is delighted at handing over very little money.
explanation.definitionFit: Money that has been spent has been paid out in exchange for something.

clue.text: Lock as part of theatre's security

indicators.note: as part of says the answer is a portion of the words that follow

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: A lock forms part of a theatre's security.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lock' suggests a door fastening, but here it is a curl of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock of hair is a tress, a long strand or curl.

clue.text: Figure out about name in reports

definitions.note: gunfire is a mass noun; reports is plural

indicators.note: out suggests the word is put out of shape and its letters rearranged
about means surrounding, so one piece wraps around another

blocks.note: taken as written
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: Someone tries to work out a name mentioned in the news reports.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reports' looks like news stories, but here it means loud bangs from guns.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is the sharp bang of a shot being fired, so a series of reports is gunfire.

clue.text: Demand too much of public ahead of a vote

indicators.note: ahead of puts the first piece in front of what follows

blocks.note: overt means open or public
taken as written
an X is the mark made on a ballot

explanation.surface: Asking too much of the public before a ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtax is to place excessive demands on someone, whether money or effort.

clue.text: With maximal organisation, temperature falls in it

indicators.note: in places the second piece inside the word that follows

blocks.note: T is the abbreviation for temperature
taken as written; it wraps the next piece
falls in the sense of perishes

explanation.surface: A neat arrangement where the temperature drops inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Falls' is not a drop in temperature but means perishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidiest is the superlative of tidy, describing whatever is most orderly or best organised.

clue.text: Tested product of mine, for example, in a small edition

indicators.note: in puts the example word inside the pieces that follow

blocks.note: taken as written
S is the abbreviation for small
say introduces an example
ED is the abbreviation for edition

explanation.surface: Someone tests a product of theirs in a small print run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mine' looks like a possessive, but it is a pit yielding ore, which is what gets assayed.
explanation.definitionFit: To assay is to analyse ore or metal for its content, so tested mined material was assayed.
